conflictLens.description: Visualize files and lines that may conflict with the base branch.
conflictLens.command.enable.title: Enable
conflictLens.command.disable.title: Disable
conflictLens.command.toggle.title: Toggle
conflictLens.command.refresh.title: Refresh
conflictLens.command.openDiff.title: Open Diff
conflictLens.config.baseBranch.descripti: Remote-tracking branch to compare against (e.g. origin/main). If unset, Conflict Lens tries to detect a default.
conflictLens.config.remoteName.descripti: Remote name used as the prefix for auto-detection candidates (<remoteName>/HEAD, <remoteName>/main, <remoteName>/master). Defaults to 'origin'.
conflictLens.config.showOverviewRuler.de: Show markers in the editor overview ruler.
conflictLens.config.showGutterIcon.descr: Show gutter icons for changed and conflicting lines.
conflictLens.config.showFileDecorationCo: Tint file names in Explorer / Open Editors for changed files.
conflictLens.config.showFileDecorationBa: Show warning badges on file names that may conflict.
conflictLens.config.enableConflictPredic: Enable strong highlight using git merge-tree (requires Git 2.38+). Disable for very large repositories.
conflictLens.config.remoteCheckIntervalM: Interval in minutes for polling remote updates with git ls-remote. Set to 0 to disable.
conflictLens.config.largeFileHunkThresho: Suppress line highlights when a file has more diff hunks than this threshold.
conflictLens.color.changedLineBackground: Background color for lines changed on the base branch (weak highlight).
conflictLens.color.conflictLineBackgroun: Background color for lines that conflict with the base branch (strong highlight).
conflictLens.color.changedFileForeground: Foreground color for files changed relative to the selected base branch.
conflictLens.color.potentialConflictFile: Foreground color for files that may conflict with the selected base branch.
conflictLens.capabilities.untrustedWorks: Conflict Lens executes git commands and reads workspace settings, so it requires a trusted workspace.
